Harbor Point Mutual Auto Insurance
Bodily Injury Unit
Claim Notes
Claim number:
C-1350
Claimant:
Sarah Perez
Adjuster:
Christopher Wong
8-7-24
The claimant reported a rear-end collision at a signalled intersection and a knee injury. The claimant is not
represented by an attorney, so all communication is directly with the claimant.
8-10-24
Police attended and filed a report. The responding officer and two independent witnesses stated that the claimant
was not inside the vehicle at the time of impact, which conflicts with the initial account and needs follow-up.
10-1-24
Photos from the scene and the ohter driver's statement both match the descriptoin of how the collision occurred. The
other driver's insurer has been notified.
11-23-24
The calimant was asked to clarify their position at impact. In a follow-up call the claimant added a few minor details,
such as the approximate speed and the lane positions, but the core account of events did not change.
12-14-24
The driver named on the policy confirmed the coverage was active at the time of loss. Nothing in the file suggests the
vehicle damage predates the policy start.
1-5-25
No prior damage to the vehicle has been identified in the records or inspection. The repair estimate is under review,
and it is not yet clear whether all listed damage came from this impact.
1-14-25
The claimant reoprted the knee injury after the collision and was seen at urgent care. The injury pattern appears
consistent with the force and direction of the impact.
2-2-25
Medical records show a standard course of physiotherapy, and the claimant's reported pain has steadily decreased
with treatment. No earlier injury to the same knee is known from the claimant's history or prior claims search.
2-19-25
Treatment is tapering off and the claimant reports improving mobility. The file will be reviewed again once the final
treatment notes are received.
3-2-25
The claim remains open pending the repair estimate review and the resolution of the discrepancy about the claimant's
position in the vehicle at impact.
</page>

List the facts written on this page. Copy each value exactly as it is written: same spelling,
punctuation and date format. Do not add anything that is not on this page. Use "" for a missing value.

Person "role" must be one of: claimant, attorney, defense_attorney, expert, doctor, officer, adjuster, witness, other.
  claimant = the person who made the claim (also called patient, plaintiff, client, customer,
  or the driver who reported it). attorney = a lawyer for the claimant or plaintiff.
  defense_attorney = a lawyer for the insurance company or defendant.
Organization "type" must be one of: repair_shop, clinic, law_firm, court, insurer, police, other.
"policy_numbers" = only values labeled as a policy number. A claim number is not a policy number.
"street" and "city" = the person's own home address, only if the page gives it. Never use the
address of a clinic, shop, firm or court for a person.
"loss_dates" = only a date that the page clearly gives as the date of the accident, crash, loss or
injury. Do not list the date of a note, letter, report, visit, statement, filing or signature.
"words_before" = the words written on the page directly before that date, copied exactly, that say
it is the loss date. Examples: "Date of loss:", "Crash date:", "Date of injury:", "the collision on".
